name: Web Design v2: Interactive Beauty and Art

cases.input: Create a website for a night garden festival. Let visitors explore the program and save a personal evening plan.
cases.rubric: Judge beauty, visual appeal and artistic expression first. Assess composition, typography, color, imagery, visual rhythm, originality and coherent art direction across screen sizes and captured interaction states. Respect the intended use, requested interactions and legibility. Judge only evidenced states; do not assume unseen flows work. No preferred style; no reward for more features, pages or content. Explain concrete visual evidence and tradeoffs. Use A/B/tie, not an absolute aesthetic score.
